en.answer:
Yes, you can.
(As long as the『if this card is in your Graveyard because it was sent there from the Extra Monster Zone this turn』activation condition is met, you can activate the effect during any phase of either player's turn while <<13944>>'s effect is applying. However, note that you cannot activate it during the Damage Step.)
en.question:
<<13944>> is in my Field Zone, and its『you can activate the effects of "Orcust" monsters in your Graveyard, or of Link Monsters you control with "Orcust" in their original names, as Quick Effects』effect is applying.

<<20948>> is in my Graveyard, and was sent there from the Extra Monster Zone this turn. Can I activate its『send 1 card on the field to the Graveyard』effect?
en.title: If <<13944>> is applying, can I activate <<20948>>'s effect during my opponent's turn?

ja.answer:
相手ターンにも発動できるようになります。
（『このカードがEXモンスターゾーンから墓地へ送られたターン』であれば、自分・相手のどちらのターンのどのフェイズでも発動できるようになります。ただし、ダメージステップには発動できません。）
